name: print-social-pale-grey-app-ideas-task-management-carousel-slide-with-three-phones
title: App Ideas Task Management Carousel Slide
whatItIs: A pale grey grainy carousel slide with a small App Ideas label, a huge black 'Task Management' title, a grey description, a green 'Productivity' word with a hand-drawn underline, three cream-green phones (an illustrated welcome, a summary with bars and a daily planner), a credit line and a swipe hint.
whatItMeans: A restrained grey ground with green-tinted phones feels calm, and a hand-drawn underline adds a human touch.
techniques: Huge black title over grey paper grain
Green as the sole accent colour
Three phones in a row at different heights
Author credit and swipe hint at the base

vocabulary.definition: A slide presenting one app concept.
A loose line drawn under a word for emphasis.
Fine noise over a flat colour for a paper feel.
